description: Answer a question about a shop that its menu doesn't: dietary needs and allergies (gluten-free, vegan, nuts), reviews, opening hours, where it is, parking, wait times, prices. Use it whenever the user asks something like that about a shop. Send the question in a few words, without names or other personal details. It only looks up what the shop has already said, and says plainly what it hasn't. Nothing goes to the shop's staff and the question isn't kept: the only trace is a count of its topic (such as "parking") in the shop's stats, like a page view.

question.description: The question in a few words, e.g. "gluten-free options?" or "is there parking?"

shop_url.description: An agentPickup shop's URL, as find_shops returns it. Defaults to https://agentpickup.app.

unverified_ok.description: Only for an unverified shop, and only after you've told the user agentPickup hasn't checked who runs it and they said to go ahead.

name: ask_about_shop
title: Ask about a shop
